analysis_block.purpose: Preserve the full analytical interpretation without action compression.

operational_translation_block.purpose: Freeze the concrete price and action translation separately from the analysis.

freeze_rules: Both blocks must be frozen at the same knowledge timestamp or explicitly declare different source timestamps.
No operational field may be added after outcome observability.
Missing values remain null and may not be inferred from narrative.
The source output remains authoritative; derived capture rows are navigation and audit artifacts only.
BTC permission and alt permission remain separate.
outcome_attachment_rules: Outcomes are attached only by existing owner scorers and verified owner datasets.
Analysis accuracy, price translation and action policy are evaluated separately.
Opportunity-cost fields use the existing evidence-ledger/FNP definitions.
